description: Symmetric/asymmetric encryption, SHA/HMAC cryptographic hashing, key derivation, and token verification morphisms.

typestates.raw: Unprocessed or raw primitive byte stream.
typestates.initialized: Cryptographic context or handle initialized with keys/parameters.
typestates.updated: Intermediate state after ingesting data blocks.
typestates.finalized: Terminal digest or derived cryptographic material ready for consumption.
typestates.written: Cryptographic artifact written to non-volatile storage.
typestates.verified: Integrity or identity check outcome evaluated.

cells.docstring: Generates a fresh cryptographically secure random 32-byte url-safe base64-encoded Fernet encryption key.
Instantiates a Fernet symmetric cipher object from a 32-byte url-safe base64-encoded secret key.
Encrypts plaintext bytes with Fernet symmetric cipher, providing 128-bit AES in CBC mode with HMAC-SHA256 authentication.
Decrypts a Fernet authenticated ciphertext token back to plaintext bytes, verifying integrity and authenticity.
Encrypts plaintext bytes with Fernet using an explicitly supplied integer Unix epoch timestamp.
Extracts the creation timestamp embedded in the Fernet ciphertext token header.
Decrypts a Fernet ciphertext token validating that token age does not exceed time-to-live ttl against current_time.

ciphertext.description: Ciphertext token to decrypt with TTL check.

ttl.description: Maximum allowed token lifetime in seconds.

plaintext.description: Decrypted plaintext bytes if token is still valid.

cells.docstring: Initializes a MultiFernet instance from an ordered list of Fernet cipher instances for key rotation.

fernet_instances.description: List of initialized Fernet instances ordered from newest to oldest.

cells.docstring: Rotates an existing Fernet token by decrypting with older keys and re-encrypting with primary key.

rotated_token.description: Rotated ciphertext encrypted under current primary key.

cells.docstring: Initializes a SHA-256 cryptographic hash state object using hashlib.
Initializes a SHA-512 cryptographic hash state object using hashlib.
Initializes a Keccak-based SHA3-256 cryptographic hash state object using hashlib.
Initializes a BLAKE2b cryptographic hash state object optimized for 64-bit platforms.
Initializes an MD5 hash state object using hashlib for legacy checksum or non-cryptographic identification.
Updates the cryptographic hash state with a chunk of bytes.

chunk.description: Byte chunk to absorb into hash computation.

cells.docstring: Finalizes hash state and returns hexadecimal string digest containing double digits.

hexdigest.description: Finalized hash digest as hexadecimal string.

cells.docstring: Finalizes hash state and returns raw bytes digest.

digest.description: Finalized hash digest as raw byte sequence.

cells.docstring: Computes SHA-256 digest directly from input bytes and formats result as hexadecimal string.
Computes SHA-512 digest directly from input bytes and formats result as hexadecimal string.
Computes SHA-256 digest directly from input bytes and returns raw 32-byte digest.
Computes SHA-512 digest directly from input bytes and returns raw 64-byte digest.
Initializes an HMAC object using a secret key and a designated digest algorithm name.
Feeds an additional data chunk into the HMAC hashing state.
Finalizes HMAC computation and returns authentication tag as hexadecimal string.
Finalizes HMAC computation and returns authentication tag as raw bytes.
Performs constant-time comparison of two digests or HMAC tags to prevent timing attacks.
Generates cryptographically secure pseudorandom bytes using OS entropy pool via os.urandom.

n_bytes.description: Number of cryptographically secure random bytes to generate.

cells.docstring: Generates a cryptographically secure random hexadecimal token string using secrets.token_hex.

n_bytes.description: Number of random bytes providing entropy for token.

cells.docstring: Generates a cryptographically secure random URL-safe base64 token string using secrets.token_urlsafe.

n_bytes.description: Number of random bytes providing entropy for token.

cells.docstring: Initializes a PBKDF2HMAC key derivation function handle with SHA-256, salt, key length, and iteration count.

length.description: Desired derived key length in bytes.

cells.docstring: Derives a cryptographic secret key from password bytes using PBKDF2.
Verifies password bytes against an expected derived key using PBKDF2HMAC verification.

expected_key.description: Reference key bytes to verify against.

is_valid.description: True if password derives to expected key, False otherwise.

cells.docstring: Constructs an HKDF key derivation instance with SHA-256 hash algorithm, salt, length, and context info.
Derives sub-key material from input keying material using HKDF extract-and-expand.
Verifies input keying material against an expected derived key using HKDF.

expected_key.description: Reference key bytes to verify against.

is_valid.description: True if derived key matches expected, False otherwise.

cells.docstring: Encodes binary byte sequence into standard Base64 ascii bytes.
Decodes standard Base64 encoded bytes back into raw binary bytes.
Encodes binary bytes into URL-safe Base64 bytes replacing '+' and '/' with '-' and '_'.
Decodes URL-safe Base64 encoded bytes back into raw binary bytes.
Parses a hexadecimal string representation into raw bytes.
Encodes binary bytes into a lowercase hexadecimal string.

raw_bytes.description: Raw bytes to serialize to hex.

cells.docstring: Generates a cryptographically strong random salt of specified byte length using os.urandom.
Derives a key using memory-hard scrypt key derivation function via hashlib.scrypt.

n.description: CPU/memory cost parameter (must be power of 2, e.g., 16384).

dklen.description: Desired derived key length in bytes.

cells.code_template: {key} = hashlib.scrypt({password}, salt={salt}, n={n}, r={r}, p={p}, maxmem={maxmem}, dklen={dklen})

Reads ciphertext token bytes from a file on disk into memory.

is_equal.description: Boolean result of constant-time digest comparison.

associated_data.description: Additional authenticated data (AAD) or empty bytes.

Instantiates an Ed25519 public key from raw 32-byte public key bytes.
